title: No Eye Contact
description: Do not look directly at passengers tonight
defaultOutcome: Averting your gaze keeps predatory spirits at bay and maintains cab stability.

followConsequences.description: You resisted the passenger's pull and finished the ride unharmed.

breakConsequences.description: Staring into a void-touched passenger shredded your sense of self.

exceptionRewards.description: Acknowledged a lonely spirit and earned supernatural goodwill.
Unlocked a heartfelt confession that opens a new narrative thread.

violationMessage: You locked eyes when you were warned not to. Something inside you unraveled.

title: Silent Night
description: No radio or music allowed during rides
defaultOutcome: Maintaining silence prevents the radio frequencies from attracting spirits.

followConsequences.description: Kept the cab quiet and avoided spectral interference.

breakConsequences.description: The song acted as a beacon for the wrong audience.
Equipment interference drained your cab's power.

exceptionRewards.description: Calmed a trembling passenger with the perfect track.
Received a protective mixtape for future rides.

violationMessage: Breaking the silence invited a chorus of voices you cannot silence.

title: Cash Only
description: Do not accept tips of any kind tonight
defaultOutcome: Hard currency keeps cursed favors from binding to you.

breakConsequences.description: A cursed coin latched onto your lifeline.
Word spread that you accept forbidden currency.

exceptionRewards.description: Offered charity to a soul who could not pay otherwise.
Unlocked a spectral favor redeemable later in the night.

violationMessage: That payment was never meant for mortal hands. It stains everything it touches.

title: Windows Sealed
description: Keep all windows closed at all times
defaultOutcome: Closed windows keep whispers, ash, and hungry winds outside the cab.

followConsequences.description: Protected the cabin from invasive spirits.

breakConsequences.description: The gale carried something inside that never left.
Air drag cut into your efficiency.

exceptionRewards.description: Saved a suffocating passenger by cracking the seal just in time.
Received a sunlight talisman for your compassion.

violationMessage: You opened the cab to the storm and something new rode with you.

title: Route Restriction
description: Do not deviate from GPS route for any reason
defaultOutcome: Following dispatch routes minimizes ambush chances and keeps dispatch happy.

followConsequences.description: Arrived on schedule without raising suspicion.

breakConsequences.description: The shortcut led you straight into a supernatural trap.
You burned fuel retracing your route through cursed alleys.

exceptionRewards.description: Passenger tipped big for getting them to safety in time.
Earned trust among nocturnal regulars for decisive driving.

violationMessage: Dispatch routes exist for a reason. The shadows were waiting off-grid.

title: Midnight Curfew
description: No pickups after midnight from cemetery locations

title: Living Passengers Only
description: Do not transport supernatural entities during thunderstorms

title: Hospital Protocol
description: Medical personnel must exit at original pickup location

title: Emergency Response
description: Always take the fastest route when passenger is in distress

title: Customer Service
description: Always comply with reasonable passenger requests

title: Safety First
description: Make eye contact with passengers to ensure they're alert

title: The Counting Rule
description: Never pick up more than 3 passengers with the same supernatural type
violationMessage: You've transported too many of the same supernatural entities. They're drawn to patterns...

title: The Time Limit
description: No single ride should take longer than 45 minutes
violationMessage: You took too long with that passenger. Time has consequences in this job...

title: The Silence Between
description: Never speak during the last 5 minutes of your shift
violationMessage: Words spoken in the final moments carry too much weight. You should have stayed quiet...

title: Storm Silence
description: Don't use windshield wipers during thunderstorms
violationMessage: The wipers disturbed something that feeds on electrical storms...

title: Light in Darkness
description: Keep headlights on during heavy fog
violationMessage: In the fog, darkness means something different. You should have kept the lights on.

title: Winter Caution
description: Drive under 25 mph in snow conditions
violationMessage: Speed in snow conditions attracted the attention of winter spirits...

title: Shelter Protocol
description: No stops during late night bad weather
violationMessage: Stopping in bad weather during the witching hour was a mistake...

title: Clear Sight
description: Don't use air conditioning when visibility drops below 30%
violationMessage: The AC created condensation just when you needed clear vision most...

title: Wind Whispers
description: Keep all windows closed during windstorms
violationMessage: The wind carried something in that you shouldn't have let inside...

title: Headlights Stay Lit
description: Never drive with the headlights off, no matter who asks.
defaultOutcome: Your lights hold the roadside shapes at the edge of the beam.

followConsequences.description: You kept the lights burning and the dark kept its distance.

breakConsequences.description: You killed the lights and the dark poured into the space they held.

exceptionRewards.description: You judged the one stretch where darkness was mercy, not invitation.
A fragment of why this rule exists surfaces.

violationMessage: You drove into blindness on purpose. Something in it had been waiting for exactly that.

title: The Unlit Mile
description: Past the last streetlight, the headlights must stay on until dawn.
defaultOutcome: Light is the only fare the far road accepts.

followConsequences.description: You held the beams steady through the dead miles and arrived whole.

breakConsequences.description: You went dark on the unlit road and the road kept you.

exceptionRewards.description: You read the single moment the dark wanted watching, not feeding.
A fragment of why this rule exists surfaces.

violationMessage: You extinguished the last light between you and whatever owns that mile.

title: No Climate Control
description: Do not run the air conditioning. The cold in the cab is not yours to change.
defaultOutcome: The unnatural chill is a truce; disturbing it ends the truce.

followConsequences.description: You let the cold sit and the passenger stayed settled in it.

breakConsequences.description: You forced the air and something reached through the vents to answer.

exceptionRewards.description: You sensed the passenger who needed warmth, not the ritual cold.
A fragment of why this rule exists surfaces.

violationMessage: You changed air that wasn't yours to move. It moved back.

title: Let the Cold Be
description: When your breath fogs but theirs does not, leave every vent shut.
defaultOutcome: The dead keep the temperature they died in; matching it keeps the peace.

followConsequences.description: You endured the cold and the frost never spread past the glass.

breakConsequences.description: You fought the chill and it climbed into your chest to stay.

exceptionRewards.description: You caught the once that the cold was cruelty, not covenant.
A fragment of why this rule exists surfaces.

violationMessage: You warmed a cabin that a dead thing had claimed. It took the warmth from you.

title: Leave the Wipers Still
description: Do not run the wipers. What streaks the glass tonight is not always rain.
defaultOutcome: Ignoring the smears on the windshield denies them your attention.

followConsequences.description: You left the glass alone and never saw what it was trying to show you.

breakConsequences.description: You wiped the glass clear and met what had been pressed against it.

exceptionRewards.description: You knew the once the glass truly needed clearing to drive safe.
A fragment of why this rule exists surfaces.

violationMessage: You cleaned the windshield and gave the thing behind the smear a clear look back.

title: The Glass Stays Wet
description: Through the whole ride, never once clear the windshield.
defaultOutcome: The film on the glass is a veil; lifting it works both ways.

followConsequences.description: You drove behind the blur and whatever watched never found your eyes.

breakConsequences.description: You cleared the veil and the watching thing found them at once.

exceptionRewards.description: You judged the single wipe that kept the road, not the ritual, safe.
A fragment of why this rule exists surfaces.

violationMessage: You lifted the veil off the glass and it lifted the veil off you.

title: Never Stop Between Fares
description: Do not stop the cab until the passenger reaches their destination.
defaultOutcome: A moving cab is a closed door; a stopped one is an open invitation.

followConsequences.description: You kept rolling and the roadside things never got their moment.

breakConsequences.description: You stopped where you shouldn't and the verge climbed in with you.

exceptionRewards.description: You read the genuine emergency that made stopping the mercy it looked like.
A fragment of why this rule exists surfaces.

violationMessage: You put the cab in park in the wrong dark. The dark got in.

title: Keep Rolling Till Dawn
description: No full stops on any leg tonight - ease, crawl, but never halt.
defaultOutcome: Momentum itself is the ward on nights like this.

followConsequences.description: You never fully stopped and the ward held to sunrise.

breakConsequences.description: You came to a dead halt and the ward broke around you.

exceptionRewards.description: You caught the one halt that saved a life instead of ending yours.
A fragment of why this rule exists surfaces.

violationMessage: You stopped dead when the rule said crawl. What was pacing you caught up.
